viewport: Desktop 1100x900; Playwright iPhone 13 emulation; composed at 1500px wide.

Mint a real one-use device pairing code with the operator API.
Open /app/#pair=<code> in a fresh emulated phone context; wait for Paired as iPhone.
Capture the connected phone and actual Devices list after the code is consumed.
Compose the two unaltered screenshots with descriptive headings; no QR/token appears.
Revoke demo devices after capture and stop the isolated phone server.
